contract.purpose: RolePatch helps job seekers prepare a resume for a specific role by connecting the job requirements to supplied experience and showing a reviewable patch.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md, PROJECT_STATUS.md, approved premium receipt with verified canonical purpose
contract.canonicalPurpose: RolePatch tailors a resume and supporting application material to the evidence and language of a specific job.
contract.audience: Job seekers organizing supplied experience and preparing a specific application.
contract.job: Enter every factual achievement, project, education and skill once in the master before tailoring for a JD.
contract.thesis: Extend the existing dialog with labeled native form sections and reusable repeatable role/project fields; retain the editor and document preview.
contract.system: Existing Geist and Space Grotesk interface, Charter paper, graphite actions, neutral surfaces, input-base fields, modal-content and native details. No footer, landing or global token changes.
contract.signature: Resume source, supplied achievements and reviewable patch stay visibly connected; familiar existing screens retain their composition.
contract.risk: A complete history can make the form long; bound the existing modal to the viewport with internal scrolling, allow saving an unfinished draft and add repeated roles/projects without deleting existing text.
contract.qualityBar: Human-readable labels, truthful empty fields, all facts preserved, useful import guidance, error recovery, keyboard operation and no horizontal overflow at 390/768/1440.
